queries.description: generateArray unnests into a dense grid, with the increment defaulting to 1
queries.sql: SELECT grid.bucket FROM {sparse} CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generateArray(0, 4)) AS grid(bucket) WHERE series = 'b' ORDER BY grid.bucket
SELECT grid.bucket FROM {sparse} CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generateArray(0, 10, 5)) AS grid(bucket) WHERE series = 'b' ORDER BY grid.bucket

queries.description: negative increment counts down, and the end is not passed when it is not on a step
queries.sql: SELECT grid.bucket FROM {sparse} CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generateArray(10, 1, -4)) AS grid(bucket) WHERE series = 'b' ORDER BY grid.bucket DESC

queries.description: epoch millis bounds generate a LONG sequence rather than overflowing an INT one
queries.sql: SELECT grid.bucket FROM {sparse} CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generateArray(1633078800000, 1633080600000, 1800000)) AS grid(bucket) WHERE series = 'b' ORDER BY grid.bucket

queries.description: a fractional increment makes the whole sequence DOUBLE
queries.sql: SELECT grid.bucket FROM {sparse} CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generateArray(0, 1, 0.5)) AS grid(bucket) WHERE series = 'b' ORDER BY grid.bucket

queries.description: WITH ORDINALITY numbers the generated buckets
queries.sql: SELECT grid.bucket, grid.pos FROM {sparse} CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generateArray(100, 300, 100)) WITH ORDINALITY AS grid(bucket, pos) WHERE series = 'b' ORDER BY grid.bucket

queries.description: gap fill: a generated grid crossed with the series keys, left joined to the sparse data and carried forward
queries.sql: SELECT grid.bucket, grid.series, COALESCE(LAST_VALUE(s.val) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY grid.series ORDER BY grid.bucket ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) FROM (SELECT g.bucket, k.series FROM UNNEST(generateArray(0, 4)) AS g(bucket) CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT series FROM {sparse}) AS k) AS grid LEFT JOIN {sparse} s ON s.eventTs = grid.bucket AND s.series = grid.series ORDER BY grid.series, grid.bucket

queries.description: a zero increment is rejected while planning instead of dividing by zero
queries.sql: SELECT grid.bucket FROM {sparse} CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generateArray(0, 4, 0)) AS grid(bucket)

queries.description: a sequence too long to materialize on the broker is rejected while planning
queries.sql: SELECT grid.bucket FROM {sparse} CROSS JOIN UNNEST(generateArray(0, 1000000)) AS grid(bucket)
